title: console: the first-run checklist's mail row ignores the live mail provider, so env- or platform-configured mail reads not done (#32799 ui half)
body:
domain:server#6 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cz8zK9vJDPeeVKJ4XP

Filing gate: ① a coordinator-ruled card's remaining half, split out after measurement. Card #32799 (coordinator item 1 on #32643, comment 6819876581: "When the platform channel is present … mail counts as configured. The checklist's mail row reads done with no administrator action"). The framework half is merged as PR #32884; this is the console half the os-dev report (`out_of_scope_findings`, class b) hands to `domain:ui`. ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the grade and the lane.

## What

Since PR #32884, `GET /api/settings/mail` serves `live.provider` as `{ value, source }`:

- `{ value: null, source: 'none' }` when the live transport is the development log (nothing delivers);
- `{ value: 'smtp' | 'resend' | 'postmark', source: 'settings' }` when it was built from the `mail` namespace;
- `{ value: 'smtp' | 'resend' | 'postmark', source: 'environment' }` when the boot built it (stack `email` block, `OS_EMAIL_*`) or the host handed over a stock transport. This is how the hosted platform channel reads (lane reading A on #32799, comment 6838162755);
- no `live` key when the provider cannot be stated.

The console's first-run checklist ignores it: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/firstRunChecklistLogic.ts` `isMailConfigured` (:485) reads only the saved `provider` / `from_email` / `smtp_host`, and `state.mail = { done: isMailConfigured(mail.values) }` (:598). A hosted tenant with no saved mail settings, or a self-hosted install that configures mail through `OS_EMAIL_*`, keeps the mail row not done although mail is delivered.

## Expected

The mail row reads done when the payload's `live.provider` states a provider in use (`value` not null, `source` `settings` or `environment`), the way `aiProviderState` (:537) reads the `ai` namespace's `live`. `source: 'none'` keeps it not done. With no `live` key (older server, or provider not stated), fall back to today's saved-values judgment. Copy that names the source, if any, must not say "platform": the server cannot tell a platform channel from a deployment's own environment.

## Reader

The `domain:ui` seat. No server change is needed; the shape is the spec's existing `SettingsNamespacePayload.live` entry.

## Duplicate check

`is:issue is:open isMailConfigured live.provider` and `is:issue is:open mail checklist live provider`: only #32799 itself (the server half).
